parameters.name: ListenerIds
parameters.description: The instance IDs. A maximum of 20 instance IDs are supported.

parameters.name: ListenerProtocol
parameters.description:
The listener protocol that you want to use as a filter. Valid values:

- **HTTP**: The protocol type is HTTP.
- **HTTPS**: The protocol type is HTTPS.
- **QUIC**: The protocol type is QUIC.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerIds
parameters.description: The Application Load Balancer (ALB) load balancing instance ID. A maximum of 20 instance IDs are supported.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of data records to read in this request. This parameter is optional. Valid values: **1** to **100**. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no next query exists.
- If a next query exists, set the value to the **NextToken** value returned in the previous API call.
